article.headline: Islanders score 3 1st-period goals, beat Ducks 3-2 for 2nd straight win
article.description: — Ondrej Palat, Viktor Eklund and Simon Holmstrom scored first-period goals and the New York Islanders beat the Anaheim Ducks 3-2 on Tuesday night for their second straight victory.
article.linkText: Islanders score 3 1st-period goals, beat Ducks 3-2 for 2nd straight win

tracking.trackingName: NHL_One-Play (Simon Holmstrom nets power-play goal) 2026/10/20 ESHEET

article.story: NEW YORK -- — Ondrej Palat, Viktor Eklund and Simon Holmstrom scored first-period goals and the New York Islanders beat the Anaheim Ducks 3-2 on Tuesday night for their second straight victory. Ilya Sorokin made 15 saves to help the Islanders improve to 3-0-1 in their last four games. Frank Vatrano and Alex Killorn scored for Anaheim, which lost its fourth straight game. Lukas Dostal finished with 22 saves. Palat opened the scoring with 6:21 left in the first period. Jean-Gabriel Pageau found Palat streaking toward the net, and the forward fired a wrist shot past Dostal. Eklund doubled the lead less than three minutes later. Emil Heineman floated a wrist shot from the blue line, and Eklund corralled the loose puck and buried it for his second goal of the season. Vatrano pulled the Ducks within a goal 49 seconds later, lifting a backhander past Sorokin off a feed from A.J. Greer. Holmstrom restored New York’s two-goal advantage with a power-play goal with 1:18 left in the first, deflecting Mathew Schaefer’s shot from the point past Dostal. Killorn pulled Anaheim within a goal with 2:40 remaining in the third. Up next Ducks: At New Jersey Thursday night. Islanders: Host Los Angeles on Thursday night. ------ See AP’s full NHL coverage here
